title: Mill Steps Café | Tao’s plan for the new menu
titleZh: 磨坊階梯咖啡店｜陶的新菜單準備計畫
passage:
Two things before tonight’s menu launch: the charge on our trial order and what happened at the counter. We use the roastery’s regular van rather than booking a separate trip. There’s one extra charge if we ask the driver to make a return trip for the same order. There’s also one if we ask the roastery to bring a case outside our usual delivery window, even if the regular van can carry it. The invoice calls both charges ‘special delivery’. We don’t pay to have an unopened case put aside; Rin suggested we do that when the stockroom is full. Our regular delivery window ends at noon. A reserve can stay at the roastery until we need it. A café employee can collect it at the roastery’s shop without a delivery charge. Rin explained how they pack a mixed order: cases left in the Delivery column are loaded together. A delivery note is read at the café, not while the warehouse packs. If we put a case in the Shop Pickup column before the list closes, the roastery sets it aside for us at the shop instead.

On the trial order, the driver brought the house blend to the front door in our usual window. The sealed decaf came to the back door after the window closed. There were two delivery slips, one at each door, and the invoice lists one special delivery. When I rang Rin she read back my message: ‘We can’t take the decaf before noon; please keep it as reserve rather than take up space in our stockroom.’ The driver told me he hadn’t left after dropping the house blend. He stayed parked out back to eat lunch and carried in the decaf when Sam opened up. Tomorrow the room will be full again until Sam clears it at 12:30. He walks past the roastery on his way back from lunch. The regular van still has space for both cases, but we’ll only have room for one when it arrives. We need the second case available tomorrow afternoon, not necessarily at the café until we open it. I need the house blend for morning service and want to avoid another special charge. The shop can sell its last decaf case to another customer unless our case is already set aside.

Last weekend we also tried two versions of the menu board. With decaf in a footnote, several customers asked whether we still had it. On the second board, the two coffees had lines of their own. Iris pointed to the decaf line. When the cashier said, ‘Sorry, which one?’ Iris looked back at the queue and said, ‘Oh, never mind. The usual.’ Later she told me, ‘I knew perfectly well what I wanted. I thought I’d already ordered.’ The cashier can see each order on the till, but customers cannot. One tester tried a drink button after that trial. It sent the choice to the till; the screen immediately returned to the payment amount. She asked if she had to tell the cashier her choice again.

During the lunch rush it’s hard for the cashier to see where someone is pointing on the board, which is beside the queue. The order screen beside the card reader is much closer. It can either display information to customers or take an input that shows up at the till, like the existing ‘here or to go’ buttons. Lunch customers often decide what to have before they reach the register; they start paying almost as soon as they get there. The screen can show the choice the till received before taking payment, or keep the last button pressed on view even if the till hasn’t received anything. We don't want a customer to read a second invitation to order after they think they're done.
passageZh:
今晚推出新菜單前，有兩件事要處理：試訂那張訂單的費用，以及櫃檯發生的事。我們用烘焙工場固定出車的貨車，不另外叫車。如果我們請司機為同一張訂單額外跑一趟，就會多收一筆費用。如果我們請工場在平常收貨時段以外送某一箱貨，即使固定班次的貨車載得下，也會多收一筆費用。帳單把這兩種費用都寫成「特殊配送」。工場代留整箱未開封的貨不收費；儲藏室滿了時，琳建議我們這樣做。我們平常的收貨時段到中午為止。 備貨可留在烘焙商那裡，到需要時再取。咖啡館員工可到烘焙商的門市自取，不收配送費。 琳解釋了混合訂單的備貨方式：留在「配送」欄的箱子會一起裝車。配送附註是到咖啡館才會看的，不是倉庫備貨時看的。如果在清單截止前，把某一箱列入「門市自取」欄，烘焙商就會留在門市供我們自取。

試訂那趟，司機在平常時段把店用配方送到前門。那箱未拆封的低咖啡因咖啡則在時段結束後才送到後門。前後門各有一張送貨單，帳單上列了一筆特殊配送費。我打電話給琳時，她把我的訊息念了一遍：「中午以前無法收低咖啡因那箱，請先留作備用，不要占我們店裡的儲藏空間。」司機告訴我，送完店用配方後他沒有開走。他把車停在後面吃午餐，等山姆開門時才把低咖啡因那箱搬進去。 明天儲藏室還是會塞滿，直到山姆在 12:30 清出空間。他吃完午餐回來時會經過烘焙商。例行貨車仍裝得下兩箱，但它到時我們只放得下一箱。明天下午必須有第二箱備用，但開箱前不必放在咖啡館。 上午營業時需要招牌配方，也不想再被加收配送費。除非門市已替我們留好低咖啡因咖啡，否則架上最後一箱可能會賣給其他顧客。

上週末我們也試了兩種點單板。低咖啡因咖啡放在附註裡時，好幾位顧客問我們還有沒有供應。第二版把兩種咖啡各列一行。艾莉絲指了低咖啡因那一行。收銀員說：「不好意思，哪一種？」艾莉絲回頭看了看排隊的人，說：「喔，算了。照平常的。」事後她跟我說：「我很清楚自己要什麼。我以為我已經點好了。」 收銀員能在收銀臺看到每筆訂單，顧客卻看不到。試驗後有位測試者按了飲品按鈕。選擇傳到了收銀臺，畫面隨即跳回付款金額。她問自己是否還得把選擇再告訴收銀員一次。

午餐尖峰時，收銀員很難看出顧客指的是隊伍旁的點單板上哪個位置。刷卡機旁的點單螢幕近得多。它可以只向顧客顯示資訊，也可以接收會出現在收銀機上的選擇，像目前的「內用或外帶」按鈕。午餐時段的顧客往往在走到收銀台前就決定了要喝什麼，一走到收銀台幾乎就開始付款。 付款前，螢幕可以顯示收銀臺已收到的選擇；也可以只顯示最後按下的按鈕，即使收銀臺還沒收到任何資料。我們不希望顧客以為已點完，卻又看到請他重新點餐的提示。
